info.name: Finance Tracker - Java backend
info.description:
Manual tests for the Spring Boot backend in BE-java (same API as the Django backend).

1. Start the app: `cd BE-java` then `.\mvnw.cmd -pl app spring-boot:run` (port from PORT in BE/.env, 2919 by default here). Through the gateway use http://localhost:8080/api/v1.
2. Select the 'Finance Tracker - Java (local)' environment or edit the baseUrl collection variable.
3. Run '01 Auth / Register', verify the email (see that request's notes) and run 'Login'. The access token is saved and sent as Bearer on every request.
4. Run the folders in order: each request saves the ids the next ones need.

Tip: for quick local testing set REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=0 in BE-java/.env so Register returns tokens directly. Change username/email variables to register a second user (e.g. for sharing).

exec: // Today's date, YYYY-MM and year/month for the requests that use them.

request.description: No authentication, no side effects.

With REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=1 (default) the response asks you to verify the email first: open the link from the email (or from the app log when EMAIL_HOST is not set), or run 'Verify email (POST)' with the uid/token from that link. With REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=0 the response already contains tokens.
